author: Ivan Erick Tlaltecatl Morales

L01.question: Does paired physical exposure alter a later signal-alone response?
L01.apparatus: two fixed C6 learner/query routes in N=34, one Runtime
L01.mechanism: cue/event collision creates a mobile relation queried later
L01.treatment: two correspondences; controls unpaired, signal-only, event-only, inverted, omitted
L01.numeric_budget_criterion: at least one query response differs from no-exposure and unpaired controls, with Applied inputs
L01.limits: one architecture, <=4 discovery settings, 2 reserves, 1 retention extension

L02.question: Does acquired history route an action before a prepared consequence arrives?
L02.apparatus: C6 directional relation, symmetric query opportunities, native later consequence
L02.mechanism: history establishes +y/-y transport; query joins it before later collision
L02.treatment: matched paired/unpaired and inverse directional histories; omitted consequence
L02.numeric_budget_criterion: history-dependent directional response and positive causal timing margin under reversed history
L02.limits: one architecture, 2 reserves, 1 timing extension; route appropriateness external frozen contract

L03.question: Can late action interception change sensory consequences and a later response?
L03.apparatus: published relational turn-loop; contingent native collision and open replay control
L03.mechanism: action product evolves into environment, return changes common readers
L03.treatment: intact vs action removed after emission vs return cut vs sham
L03.numeric_budget_criterion: post-emission cut changes return and subsequent body response
L03.limits: 2 interface families maximum; sensory matching and learned contingency remain explicit pending requirements

L04.question: Do fixed learned relations act consistently on held-out physical query realizations?
L04.apparatus: same two C6 routes; translated queries and new payloads
L04.mechanism: mobile acquired relation transforms query in a physical collision
L04.treatment: distinct paired event consequences vs absent/inverted correspondences
L04.numeric_budget_criterion: nonzero between-class residual separation and zero within-class variation on reserved payloads
L04.limits: domain is finite transport/translation; no post-hoc learned decoder; inherited route symmetry is preparation

L05.question: Can one query physically use two separately acquired relations in sequence?
L05.apparatus: two C6 learned mobile relations at different hubs in one N=34 Runtime
L05.mechanism: query meets relation1 at 11, then relation2 at 16
L05.treatment: full, omit1, omit2, both omitted, late intermediate carrier cut
L05.numeric_budget_criterion: common final query differs under both history omissions and intermediate route cut
L05.limits: one sum/route architecture, 2 reserves, one retained-path extension; no symbolic composition claim

L06.question: How does identical history express after native intervals without new inputs?
L06.apparatus: relational and contextual basal presets, recurrent reader present/cut
L06.mechanism: local phase/context recurrence plus common probe on isolated diagnostic branches
L06.treatment: AB, H0, BA and recurring-reader cut; common probes at 1/25/100/170
L06.numeric_budget_criterion: same-history physical query signature differs between horizons or recurrence cut
L06.limits: two preset families; propagation/phase vs historical reorganization not automatically adjudicated

L07.question: What functional recovery occurs after declared damage with no host restoration?
L07.apparatus: H3 calibration and separate basal damage/readiness experiment
L07.mechanism: trained backup vs native basal recurrence following local loss
L07.treatment: intact, damage A, support cut, identical-copy sham; H3 no-backup/path controls
L07.numeric_budget_criterion: lost signature subsequently returns without repair writes and depends on prepared/history controls
L07.limits: H3 is coupled calibration, not new autonomous maintenance; 2 architectures maximum

L08.question: Does a learned emitter effect reach a receiver whose own acquired relation alters its response?
L08.apparatus: C6 emitter y relation and receiver z relation in one N=34 Runtime
L08.mechanism: same mediator reaches receiver at 16; acquired receiver relation alters direction
L08.treatment: full, emitter unexposed, receiver unexposed, late channel cut, inverted receiver direction
L08.numeric_budget_criterion: receiver direction depends on both emitter and receiver histories and channel cut
L08.limits: finite mobile-relation apparatus; no full persistent material body or language claim

L09.question: Can history-selected routes expose a hidden environmental state and affect later output?
L09.apparatus: basal +y/-y routes with remote load condition on one native turn source
L09.mechanism: history biases route; source difference becomes accessible only through downstream interaction
L09.treatment: two hidden loads, AB/BA/H0, local-prefix equality and return cut
L09.numeric_budget_criterion: equal initial local signature, differing return, different subsequent action; informative-route preference itself must be acquired
L09.limits: one candidate interface; externally prepared preference does not establish information-seeking acquisition

selection_policy: Visit one case in each branch before second pass. Finite numerical contrasts select confirmation, never cognitive verdict.
budget: 90 minutes including preparation and packaging; close at <=80 minutes if runner still has queued cases
sources: Fixed pre-T0 native preparation or preregistered external inputs; declared diagnostics only in isolated forks
host_boundary: No response-adaptive stimulus, full-state input, decoder fitting, or repair

technical_hotfixes.fix: new case using explicit Runtime research timing; preserved rejected case
enum equality; counts recalculated from saved receipts, physical arrays untouched

technical_hotfixes.correction: Imported existing passive serializer, no physical parameter change.
technical_hotfixes.scope: first unfinished supplementary arm; other completed experiments not rerun

combinations.resources: full and route sham same initial native carriers; omissions separately record dose differences
combinations.origin: all relations acquired at tick 3 in the new joint Runtime; never combined learned snapshots

coverage_pending.L01: Signal identity is a fixed physical route/direction; no symbolic association decoder.
coverage_pending.L02: Early acquired routing is measured. Learned temporal expectation vs transport timing is not separated by this first apparatus.
coverage_pending.L03: Late native action/return cuts and one-site external replay measured, with two translated repetitions. Learned distinction between C/U and interface swap remain unexecuted.
coverage_pending.L04: Reserved finite query transforms are measured; broader acquisition of categories beyond fixed physical interfaces is untested.
coverage_pending.L05: Transformations are additive/mobile and queries transform the same carriers.
coverage_pending.L06: Early probes valid; some original late probes rejected occupied. New quiescent context is a distinct declared preparation.
coverage_pending.L07: H3 is calibration only. Native damaged basal states are measured without host repair; whole acquired signature restoration must be read from data.
coverage_pending.L08: Finite emitter/receiver relational histories, not independently renewed complete material bodies. Acquired symbolic code untested.
coverage_pending.L09: Hidden source condition also reaches uninformative route backgrounds; acquired choice of informative intervention not isolated.
